[[File:Miscellaneous_regions.jpg|thumb|right|200px|[[Allied Region]]s and Imperial client states (in grey).]]
'''Imperial client states''' referred to semi-independent [[Sector/Legends|sectors]] that were economically, politically, or militarily subordinate to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Era]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>

These states did not answer directly to [[Coruscant/Legends|Imperial Center]], but rather owed some form of allegiance to the Empire. They could not oppose the Empire militarily or dare to work against the Empire's goals publicly. Some client states were the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]], the [[Centrality/Legends|Centrality]], the [[Hapes Consortium/Legends|Hapes Consortium]], the [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]]<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Corellian sector/Legends|Corellian sector]]<ref name="SoF">''[[Suns of Fortune]]''</ref> in addition to the few remaining [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]'s [[Allied Region]]s.<ref name="TEA" /> The Galactic Empire maintained [[Imperial Embassy|embassies]] in these client states.<ref name="LotE">''[[Lords of the Expanse]]''</ref>
